description: Plan de Protección civil de Boadella i les Escaules is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webspobles2.ddgi.cat. The Civil Protection Plan of Boadella i les Escaules, aims to be the organic framework that coordinates the Actions and Response of the Public Services intended for attention and Emergency response within the municipality. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Boadella i les Escaules Civil Protection plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Boadella i les Escaules, Civil protection plan, Riesgos naturales, Riscos naturals, Pla de protecció civil, Plan de protección civil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
